name: @fixture/vault
description: A package that fills the data module's native slot with a prebuilt library (LLP 1154 §3 item 4): its TypeScript driver is its "." export; exact.json "native" names the Rust shim, which calls the library and opens a SQLite file through the storage the host admits; "web" declares an asset. test/library.mjs builds the library and the package that declares it.
